Chapter 200: Bloody Battle (2)

Chapter 200: Bloody Battle (2)

“Yes, now the Nine Saint Demon Gate will perish, and that brat wouldn’t dare to fart loudly at this moment at wherever he is hiding. Hmph, if he dares to come here, then big brother Shengtian will surely kill him with one move.” The amount of flatterers was not few.

Of course, many Royal Nobles and sect masters looked down on these flatterers. But they couldn’t deny that with the backing of the two great powers, the Heavenly God Sect will surely thrive like the sun at high noon!

“Boom!”

At this time, Chi Yun finally lost to Wan Shengjian and was knocked away by one strike as he crazily spewed out blood. Wan Shengjian then coldly sneered and void stepped to chase right behind.

“Kill..” At this time, the Heavenly God Sect disciples’ morale was high with unstoppable momentum while the Nine Saint Demon Gate disciple kept on retreating with many injured and dead. This situation had deteriorated and was extremely difficult to reverse the trend!

“Haha, it is almost over for the Nine Saint Demon Gate. Opposing the Heavenly God Sect and the Azure Mysterious Ancient Kingdom surely will not end well.” Seeing the remaining disciples of the Nine Saint Demon Gate with nowhere to go, some cultivators were happily smiling.

These flatterers began to speak cold and sarcastic comments, some even mockingly jeered.

In fact, not everyone wanted to see the Heavenly God Sect’s ascension. But this was already a foregone conclusion. Heavenly God Sect’s ancestor was a general under Immortal Emperor Ta Kong, so they surely had support from the Trample Emptiness Mountain. Now after climbing up the Ancient Kingdom, this fortified their inevitable rise. Maybe in this generation, the Heavenly God Sect will actually become a true Kingdom!

“Haha, ah, where is that haughty and arrogant brat Li hiding at now? The Nine Saint Demon Gate won’t do for long, and the brats of the Cleansing Incense Ancient Sect over there are finished soon as well! Ah, little Li is probably scared out of his wits and is hiding below his mother’s skirt not daring to come out ah…” A young prodigy was very pleased and loudly bursted out in laughter!

“Bang!” But after this young prodigy’s words came out, a shadow with unparalleled speed pummeled forward causing him to fly up in the air as blood spurted out like the majestic spring. The crisp sounds of broken bones were heard clearly by everyone nearby.

When this prodigy fell to the ground, he was no longer breathing for he was dead on the spot.

“What about the Azure Mysterious Ancient Sect? Do you think such a small sect like this could scare your grandfather?” At this time, an unhurried voice rang as Li Qiye stepped forward with a cold, high spirited demeanor looking at the crowd.

“Li Qiye, that brat from the Cleansing Incense Ancient Sect!” Seeing Li Qiye’s sudden appearance, everyone couldn’t help but became alarmed. Li Qiye’s cultivation didn’t matter. The Emperor’s Possession in his hand alone was enough to make people dread!

“Li Qiye…” After seeing his appearance, Dao Child Shengtian cried out with a roar filled with anger and animosity. Followed his roar was a Virtuous Paragon’s aura shooting up to the sky. Suddenly, all of his blood energy channeled up high in the sky.

Dao Child Shengtian wished that he could drink Li Qiye’s blood and taste his flesh, flaying his skin. He would never be able to erase the humiliation in blood unless he killed Li Qiye. So, right when Li Qiye showed up, he immediately shouted and took out his Virtuous Paragon Life Treasure to directly aim for Li Qiye, wanting to kill him before he has the chance to take out the Emperor’s Possession!

“A declining Cleansing Incense Ancient Sect, only an Emperor’s Possession isn’t shit!” As Dao Child Shengtian was rushing forward, Ji Kongjian also shouted and took out his inkstone with its immediate rolling emperor’s power.

Dao Child Shengtian and Ji Kongjian had the same thought and both attacked at the same time, wanting to give Li Qiye a mortal blow without a chance to take out his Emperor’s Possession!

“Scram!” Before Dao Child’s Virtuous Paragon Life Treasure could strike down, the separated Yin and Yang along with the six dao culminating into a sword traversing the heaven came down with a “clank”. With just one blow, it repelled the Virtuous Paragon Life Treasure.

The cry of one sword pulling down the heaven like a flooding waterfall from above came straight down creating the Six Dao Sword Formation and in a flash trapped Dao Child Shengtian inside.

“Opposing my Heavenly God Sect, your Nine Saint Demon Gate will surely meets its demise!” Dao Child Shengtian caught his Life Treasure and yelled out! At this moment, his Life Treasure hang above his head and its energy reached the Dipper and Ox constellations above!

Li Shuangyan naturally wouldn’t give Dao Child Shengtian and Ji Kongjian a chance to attack Li Qiye together, so her Six Dao Sword immediately slashed straight towards Dao Child.

“Only a previous loser against me, can’t reach the apex.” Li Shuangyan coldly exclaimed like the cold, domineering apricots in the middle of the snow.

“Kill!” Being disdained like this by Li Shuangyan caused Dao Child to explode with anger. He shouted and released his Life Treasure onward. Li Shuangyan also roared as her Six Dao Sword traversed the heaven to form a sword formation trapping the heaven and earth along with Yin and Yang. As the clanking sounds of the sword appeared, the reincarnation cycle of the six dao cut through everything!”

Li Shuangyan wielding the Six Dao Sword had a heavenly oppressive aura. With her sword formation sweeping through the sky, Dao Child Shengtian was still at a disadvantage even with his Virtuous Paragon Life Treasure. One had to know that the Six Dao Sword was much stronger than a Virtuous Paragon Life Treasure!

“Boom!” With a blink of an eye, the inkstone in Ji Kongjian’s hand surged with a deluge of Emperor’s power and turned into the word “Subjugate”, and it immediately felt as if an Immortal Emperor striking forward with his spear.

An Immortal Emperor’s subjugation shook the heaven and earth causing the sky and clouds to lose their colors as all beings prostrate in worship! The celestials above immediately lost their glimmers.

“Zhang…” The sound of the zither appeared as Li Qiye began to pluck his ancient instrument. The Emperor’s power intensified turning into a heavenly sword hanging above the nine heavens. One swing to destroy all six dao, and one swing to collapse the Yin and Yang!

“Boom!” Another loud explosion occurred trembling the entire Ancient Sky City. One sword versus one spear blow for blow over millions of miles creating fiery sparks that were more blinding than even the sun in the sky. As if sun after sun were exploding from the impacts.

As the emperor’s powers raged above the Ancient Sky City, countless people’s legs became weak as they sat straight down on their butts! Under the emperor’s power, even Enlightened Beings were shaking in fear.

“Again..” After an unsuccessful strike, the arrogant Ji Kongjian angrily roared and propelled the inkstone causing all the inks inside to immediately turn into the word “Subjugate”. All of the remaining emperor’s power amalgamated under this one attack.

“Zhang-” Li Qiye played the zither one more time without holding anything back. As the underserved melodies reached the sky, all of its emperor’s power surged forward creating a huge heavenly sword once more.

“Booom!’ The battle spear battled against the heavenly sword up in the nine layers of heaven. Blow after blow before the spear finally shattered along with the broken heavenly sword. Under this collision, stars after stars in the nine heavens crumbled. When the remaining emperor’s powers descended down to the Ancient Sky City, numerous cultivators were no longer able to stand still. This contest was outside of the horizon, but the falling remnants of emperor’s powers were still extremely horrifying!

Crank! The sound of the inkstone cracking resonated. Zhang—, and Li Qiye’s ancient zither also lost three of its strings.

After both sides utilized all of their emperor’s powers, nothing remained as the once invincible Emperor’s Possessions turned into mortal items, no longer carrying the Emperor’s aura!

Both sides were so fierce and immediately used Emperor’s Possessions right at the start of the battle, and simply didn’t treasure these priceless Emperor’s items. This stunned all of the watching spectators. These were truly Immortal Emperor’s heritages, not an ounce of hesitation in using Emperor’s Possessions as if they were worthless. Such boldness and luxurious actions could only be taken by disciples of Immortal Emperor’s heritages.

“Kill..” At this juncture, the group of Chen Baojiao, Shi Gangdang, and Niu Fen had also joined the battlefield. Chen Baojiao rushed straight towards the Cleansing Incense Ancient Sect’s disciples, wanting to save these juniors. Shi Gangdang on the other hand roared with majestic grandeur and went straight towards an elder of the Nine Saint Demon Gate.

Niu Fen immediately saved Chi Yun from his precarious position, and then immediately used his tentacles to catch more than a dozen of Heavenly God Sect’s disciples and swallowed them. Such ferocity left many Heavenly God Sect’s disciples in fear with their legs shivering, not daring to come close to Niu Fen.

“Little demon, accept your death!” The prideful Ji Kongjian couldn’t accept the fact that even by expending an Emperor’s Possession, it still wasn’t enough to kill Li Qiye. Wearing his armor and changed his hand into an imperial palm capable of repressing dragons, he aimed straight towards Li Qiye.

“So suicidal!” Li Qiye smiled. Attacking with bare hand meant that Ji Kongjian simply did not see through his Hell Suppressing Godly Physique.

Li Qiye without any moves or transformation flashed his body. As rumblings came out, his body directly slammed forward. It was the most powerful of weapons, just like a tyrannical dragon.

“Banggg!” Even an Emperor’s law was not enough to counter the Hell Suppressing Godly Physique. Li Qiye’s shoulder heavily slammed into Ji Kongjian’s body. “Crank crack” sounds of shattering appeared as Ji Kongjian’s armor was annihilated on the spot, followed by the sounds of broken bones as his entire body flew backward and crazily spurt out blood.

Li Qiye did not show any mercy as he jumped up in the sky and substantially came directly down like a thousand mountains right on the flying Ji Kongjian.

“Treasure open…” With death before his eyes, Ji Kongjian shouted and suddenly, there was a long box in front of him. It opened followed by an immediate flying saber slashing forward.

The flying saber’s speed was unparalleled. This blade was like the crescent moon in the night sky, pretty and flirtatious yet coldly severe!

“Boom!” Li Qiye’s attack was met by the slashing saber resulting in a loud blast. Blood was spilled as Li Qiye was cut by the flying saber. Even his fortified body was chopped leaving a deep cut revealing bare bones.

This flying saber had a remarkable origin, but the Hell Suppressing Godly Physique was not just for show. “Clank” sound bellowed. It did not matter that his body was cut, the thing knocked flying away in the end was still the flying saber. This flying saber with its frightening origin was still suppressed under Li Qiye’s physique and became dull without any brilliance!
